prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game animation sprite sheet on true transparent background, 4 columns by 3 rows, exactly 12 full-body poses, no text, no borders. Reference image is the definitive character design only, do not crop its miniature poses. Character: Corrupted Guardian, massive black gunmetal armored humanoid giant with cracked molten orange seams, round bright orange chest reactor, tall central helmet crest, angular orange eyes, spiked shoulders, large articulated fists, armored legs. Match reference proportions and comic-book ink shading. All poses three-quarter view facing RIGHT, same size, orthographic side-scroller view. Each cell generous transparent padding, no overlapping neighboring cells, full feet and crest visible. Row 1 four idle breathing poses: relaxed, chest lift, settle, exhale; subtle weight shift. Row 2 four walking cycle poses: right step contact, down passing, left step contact, up passing, coherent grounded legs with different arm swings. Row 3 four basic punch poses: fist drawn back, deep windup, full rightward extended punch, recovery retract. Keep anatomy and armor consistent, only pose changes. Isolated character, no background, no ground shadow, no labels, no weapons added. Landscape sheet 1536x1024.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet true transparent background, exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows, 12 full-body sequential animation poses. First image is definitive design; second is animation styling/scale reference. Same Corrupted Guardian black metal armored massive giant, molten orange seams, orange round chest reactor, tall helmet crest, shoulder spikes. Same anatomy, four limbs, facing RIGHT three-quarter orthographic game view. NO text or cell borders. Generous clear gutters all cells, full body and all effects within its own cell. Row1 pollution projectile attack: 1 hands gather near chest, 2 chest reactor charging hands framing it, 3 right hand extends launching a compact orange energy orb to right, 4 hand retracts reactor dims. Row2 environment rubble summon: 1 knees bend hands low, 2 both arms overhead summoning, 3 arms pull down with small falling stone fragments alongside body, 4 lower arms recovery. Row3 ground slam: 1 stand hands together, 2 both fists raised overhead, 3 crouch both connected fists smashing floor, 4 lifting torso fists off floor. Each row is coherent windup, stronger windup, attack contact, recovery. Maintain consistent body scale even crouching. No backdrop, no ground shadow or terrain. Landscape1536x1024. Do not reuse idle poses for attack.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite sheet exactly FOUR columns THREE rows, 12 full-body animation poses. First reference definitive Corrupted Guardian character, second establishes rendered armor and proportions. Huge black metal armored humanoid, orange molten seams, orange circular chest core, tall crest, spiked shoulders, two arms two legs. Comic-book ink shading, facing RIGHT three-quarter side-scroller view. Each pose fully isolated inside own equal cell with generous transparent padding, no overlapping across cells. Row1 CATACLYSM energy shockwave attack: 1 arms folded protect glowing chest, 2 both arms pulling back reactor supercharges, 3 both arms spread wide chest thrust forward with tight orange energy aura, 4 arms lowering and reactor returning normal. Row2 HIT reaction: 1 struck torso leans back, 2 shoulders recoil knees buckle, 3 bracing with one hand across chest, 4 recovering upright. Row3 DEFEAT collapse: 1 chest light falters knees bending, 2 drops to one knee torso droops, 3 falls onto side supported on forearm, 4 lying fully collapsed horizontally on ground reactor extinguished dark orange. No gore; solid connected armor not loose rubble. Same scale across all poses, last poses lower because lying down. Keep ALL limbs feet and helmet fully visible. No scenery, no ground shadow, no floor, no labels, no text. Landscape1536x1024. Actual transparent alpha background.
processing: Original generated RGBA retained. Deterministic packer isolates each newly authored full-body pose, removes neighboring/disconnected fragments, preserves antialiased alpha, scales uniformly and aligns ground anchors. Concept miniatures are not animation sources.
limitations: Four authored poses per state; additional hand-drawn in-between frames could improve fluidity.
Detached gameplay projectiles and area warnings remain controlled by the unchanged combat renderer.
